engine: GSAP 3.15 (ScrollTrigger, SplitText) for the button roll-up, hero reveal, statement zoom and quote highlight; CSS transitions for tabs, FAQ, mobile menu, carousels; a custom Swiper-like hook for carousels.

gsapSetup.note: Single plugin registration point; ScrollTrigger.refresh() on document height changes and fonts.ready.

noScrollFadeIns.statement: Sections, headings, cards and images do NOT fade in on scroll. There is no generic reveal pattern, and the closed pattern enum deliberately has none.

reducedMotion.statement: Neither the original site nor this clone has any prefers-reduced-motion handling (grep of src/, index.html and tailwind.config.js finds none). The PageSpec schema nevertheless REQUIRES a reducedMotionFallback on every node so generated pages get one; each fallback below is a generation requirement, not a description of the source.

easing.outQuart: cubic-bezier(0.165, 0.84, 0.44, 1) (CSS fallback; linear() quartic where supported) -- Webflow IX2 outQuart
easing.inOutQuart: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) (CSS fallback; linear() quartic where supported)
easing.tailwind-default: Tailwind's default transition timing cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), applied where the clone sets a duration class but no ease class

reducedMotionFallbacks.instant-toggle: Switch open/closed or active state immediately, without the transition.
reducedMotionFallbacks.instant-final-state: Render the end state immediately (fully visible, unscaled, final colour). No scroll scrub, no load reveal.
reducedMotionFallbacks.instant-slide-change: Change slides without the 800ms transform transition; manual controls keep working.
reducedMotionFallbacks.autoplay-off-instant-slide-change: Do not autoplay; render paused with the play control available; slide changes are instant.

none.description: No section-level motion. Hover colour transitions on buttons/links and the button letter roll-up are primitive behaviour, not section motion.

nav.hoverMenus.description: Desktop dropdowns open instantly on hover and close 300ms after pointer-leave (no tween). Top-level item hover bg 320ms, dropdown item hover 360ms, AI link bg 250ms / width 500ms. Mobile menu (<=991): opacity 0->1 + translateY 20->0 over 650ms outQuart in; close to opacity 0 / y 10 over 350ms, unmounted after 400ms.

hero.loadReveal.description: On load: avatar row (500ms), h1 (1250ms), subtitle and badges (1250ms, +250ms), buttons (1250ms, +350ms) from opacity 0 / y 40|10 / scale .9 / skewX 10|8 / blur 20|8|5px to rest. GSAP power3.out (= IX2 outQuart). Initial states set in a layout effect before first paint. The hero image is NOT animated.

tabs.crossFade.description: Click-driven pane + copy cross-fade: opacity and visibility .3s ease. No autoplay.

carousel.dragLoop.description: Swiper-like loop, 1 slide per view, 24px gap, 800ms CSS ease slide transition; tab click goes to slide; drag threshold 5px, 45deg touch angle, short swipe (<300ms) always advances, long swipe advances past 50% of a step. NO autoplay.

carousel.autoplayOnView.description: Autoplay starts once 40% of the slider container is visible (IntersectionObserver 0.4, once): jump to slide 0, then play. Delay 3000ms after each 800ms ease transition. Active bullet widens 24->48px (500ms ease) while playing; its fill runs bulletProgress 3s linear. Play/pause toggle. Drag threshold 5px.

scroll.zoomScrub.description: GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub 0.9 on the statement visual: scale 2.5 / x 23 / y -447 / opacity 0 -> identity / opacity 1, start 'top 55%', end 'top 5%', ease none, origin centre.

scroll.charColorScrub.description: SplitText chars on the quote tween colour from the base #1a1a1a (surface-3) to #fff: 1.5s per char, stagger {amount: 10}, power4.inOut, ScrollTrigger start clamp(top 500) / end clamp(bottom 500), scrub 0.8.

carousel.centeredAutoplay.description: Centred loop carousel, autoplay from init with 4000ms delay, pauses while the pointer is over it (mouse only) and resumes with the remaining time. Centre slide scale 1.1 / opacity 1, others .95 / .2 (300ms ease); info panel fades in 300ms; active bullet 40px (300ms) with a 4s linear fill; bullets are not clickable. Drag threshold 10px.

accordion.faq.description: Each item toggles independently. Open: body grid-rows 0fr->1fr, opacity 0->1, scaleY .7->1 over 450ms outQuart. Close: 650ms outQuart. Icon rotates 45deg->0 over 150ms inOutQuart. CSS transitions with cubic-bezier fallbacks and linear() quartic curves.

footer.dropup.description: Legal drop-ups open upward on click (inline at <=767); chevron rotates 0->180deg over 300ms ease. Link/social hover colour 240ms; column-header hover 200ms (>=1440 only).

button.letterRollUp.description: Every Button: SplitText words+chars on the label; chars y 0 -> -1.5em, 0.45s, stagger {amount: .25}, power4.inOut; mouseenter plays, mouseleave reverses. The label's text-shadow copy (0 1.5em) rolls up into the 20px mask. Background colour transition 240ms ease in parallel.
